invariant: Native signed decisions may be correlated to an observed runtime request by an explicitly trusted operator transport; neither discovery, correlation nor historical receipt grants current authority.
priorFailure: The transport receives no runtime-call identity. Identical requests and replayed proofs cannot safely be joined by time, body or proof ID alone.
design: Optional out-of-band fetch context with runtime epoch, owning leaf run, owning capability and distinct actual-request ID.
No context in HTTP parameters, credentials, retained knowledge or grant decisions; contract discovery remains unassociated.
Resource responds with native artifact digest and native gate request ID; transport journals that response reference with the exact wire and local context.
Optional adapter verifies native signatures and exact signed wire before projecting operator correlation. No copied cryptography.
Dashboard only links current-epoch retained runtime observations. Current authority remains unknown.
controls: Concurrent operations, redirects, asynchronous continuation, MCP session reuse and unrelated protocol
Denied dispatch and discovery produce no execution association
Changed wire, artifact reference, native request ID, duplicate mapping and foreign runtime rejected or unlinked
Replay refusal cannot inherit the earlier accepted attempt's association
Lost response has no association; partial/oversized verifier input fails closed
Legacy optional adapter and existing security regressions stay passing
evaluation: Same-author development controls, not independently authored holdouts. Freeze passing implementation before live local experiment; preserve baseline and failed trials. No model calls or external effects required.

reused: native signed artifact action and target
